sentences.text: No, for a floating rate loan to an individual for a purpose other than business that was sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges.
The directions for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026 say that, in cases other than the stated exceptions, pre-payment charges are only as per the UCB's approved policy.
The older floating-rate pre-payment charge circulars are no longer in force on the as-of date.
